title: M_W(T) ≤ C·μ(W∖K) for a compact K with null rotated projections (Simon 6, proof of 2.36, displays (1)–(3))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P, and T ∈ D_n(U) with M_W(T) + M_W(∂T) < ∞ for every open W ⊂⊂ U. Let μ be a Borel measure on ℝ^P and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) be such that (IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) the function x ↦ ⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ = ξ(x)(ω(x)) is μ-integrable and T(ω) = ∫⟨ω(x), ξ(x)⟩ dμ(x). Assume also that Σ_{β∈I(n,P)} ξ(x)(dx^β)² = 1 for μ-a.e. x. Let Q be a linear isometry of ℝ^P, and let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact with Lⁿ(π_α(K)) = 0 for every α ∈ I(n,P), where π_α(x) := ((Qx)_{α(0)}, …, (Qx)_{α(m)}). Then there is a constant C ≥ 0 such that M_W(T) ≤ C·μ(W∖K) for every open W ⊂⊂ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W + T.boundary.massOn W < ∞) → ∀ (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)), IsMeasureRepresentation T μ ξ → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∑ β : SimonMultiIndex (m + 1) P, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate (ξ x) β) ^ 2 = 1) → ∀ (Q : Eucl P ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Eucl P) (K : Set (Eucl P)), IsCompact K → (∀ α : SimonMultiIndex (m + 1) P, (volume : Measure (Eucl (m + 1))) ((fun x : Eucl P => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => Q x (α i)) : Eucl (m + 1))) '' K) = 0) → ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → T.massOn W ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W \ K)
